stories.title: Trump consultó a Grok sobre reacción venezolana antes de capturar a Maduro; "quedó impresionado", revela revista Time

en.title: Trump consulted Grok about Venezuelan reaction before capturing Maduro; "was impressed", Time magazine reveals
en.summary: Trump consulted the AI system Grok one month before U.S. forces captured Venezuelan former president Maduro in January, according to Time magazine.

stories.title: Andy López Beltrán se registra como aspirante a diputado federal en Tabasco por Morena; busca coordinar la 4T en el Distrito 6

en.title: Andy López Beltrán registers as federal deputy candidate in Tabasco for Morena; seeks to coordinate the 4T in District 6
en.summary: The son of former Mexican president López Obrador registered as a candidate for federal deputy with the Morena party in Tabasco after resigning from the party's organizational secretary position in May.

stories.title: La Suprema Corte resolvió la validez de las fotomultas en la CDMX

en.title: The Supreme Court resolved the validity of photo citations in Mexico City
en.summary: Mexico's constitutional court determined that vehicle owners are jointly responsible for paying fines issued through traffic camera violations, regardless of whether they personally committed the traffic violation.

stories.title: Braves rompen racha y cierran Series Divisionales 2026

en.title: Braves break streak and close 2026 Division Series
en.summary: The Atlanta Braves won their first playoff game against Philadelphia and secured a Wild Card spot, with the defending champion Dodgers as their next opponent.

stories.title: Nuevo ataque contra un buque en el estrecho de Ormuz

en.title: New attack against a ship in the Strait of Hormuz
en.summary: A vessel was attacked in the Strait of Hormuz, a critical waterway through which one-fifth of global hydrocarbons previously transited before the war, amid escalating tensions between the US-Israel alliance and Iran.

stories.title: John Cena conquista la CDMX durante la presentación de la cinta "Matchbox"

en.title: John Cena conquers Mexico City during the presentation of the film "Matchbox"
en.summary: Actor John Cena appeared in Mexico City to promote the film Matchbox, in which he plays Sean Walker, a former soldier turned CIA agent.

stories.title: Juez rechaza pedido de absolución de Lindsay Clancy, madre que mató a sus tres hijos en EU

en.title: Judge rejects motion to dismiss charges against Lindsay Clancy, mother who killed her three children in the US
en.summary: A Massachusetts judge determined there was sufficient evidence to proceed to trial against Lindsay Clancy in the deaths of her three children, rejecting her defense attorney's motion for dismissal.

stories.title: EU ha revocado más de 250 mil visas bajo el mando de Trump, reportan; medida es parte de campaña contra migración

en.title: US has revoked more than 250 thousand visas under Trump's leadership, reports say; measure is part of campaign against migration
en.summary: The Trump administration has revoked over 250,000 visas as part of its immigration enforcement efforts, with a State Department spokesperson calling it a historic milestone for protecting Americans.

stories.title: Diputada local de MC impulsa crear protocolo de atención para animales lesionados en hechos de tránsito; buscan establecer ruta homologada

en.title: Local MC Congresswoman Promotes Protocol for Treating Injured Animals in Traffic Incidents; Seeks to Establish Standardized Route
en.summary: A local legislator is proposing a protocol to ensure injured animals are not abandoned at traffic accident scenes and to establish a standardized care procedure.

stories.title: Aseguran ocho vehículos en bodega de Guasave, Sinaloa; tenían reporte de robo y blindaje artesanal

en.title: Eight Vehicles Seized in Guasave Warehouse, Sinaloa; Had Theft Reports and Makeshift Armor
en.summary: State police and Mexican military seized eight vehicles from a warehouse that had been reported stolen and contained improvised armor plating, along with ammunition and cartridges.

stories.title: Se registra 'Andy' en Tabasco; va por diputación

en.title: 'Andy' Registers in Tabasco; Running for Congress
en.summary: Andrés López, son of AMLO, registered as a Morena coordinator in Tabasco to seek a federal congressional seat.

stories.title: Reportan nuevo ataque a buque en el Estrecho de Ormuz

en.title: New Attack Reported on Vessel in Strait of Hormuz
en.summary: A vessel was attacked in the Strait of Hormuz by an unidentified projectile that caused a fire, according to the UKMTO agency.

stories.title: Así puedes convertir tu celular Android o iOS en una tarjeta para pagar sin efectivo

en.title: How you can turn your Android or iOS phone into a card to pay without cash
en.summary: Smartphones can be configured to function as payment cards for cashless transactions. Multiple banks offer compatibility with both iPhone and Android devices for this feature.

stories.title: Christa Pike recibió dos inyecciones letales, sobrevivió y su fallida ejecución reavivó el debate sobre la pena

en.title: Christa Pike received two lethal injections, survived, and her failed execution reignited the death penalty debate
en.summary: An execution in a Tennessee prison failed after the inmate survived two lethal injections. The case has renewed discussion about capital punishment.

stories.title: Sucursales de Monte de Piedad abrirán a partir de esta fecha tras acabarse la huelga: ¿qué pasará con los empeños?

en.title: Branches of Monte de Piedad will open from this date after the strike ends: what will happen with the pawns?
en.summary: A strike at Nacional Monte de Piedad ended on September 30th, with an announcement regarding when customers can return to branches.

stories.title: Día del Café: café a 1 peso en OXXO y gratis en La Esperanza este 1 de octubre en CDMX

en.title: Coffee Day: coffee at 1 peso at OXXO and free at La Esperanza on October 1st in Mexico City
en.summary: Several chains are offering limited-time coffee promotions on October 1st. Some offers require using a mobile app, bringing a personal thermos, or making an additional purchase.

stories.title: El SAT perdió 4,600 millones de pesos en IVA e impuestos especiales por huachicol fiscal

en.title: SAT Lost 4,600 Million Pesos in VAT and Special Taxes Due to Fiscal Fuel Smuggling
en.summary: Mexico's tax authority identified 109,400 million liters of undeclared fuel after a 10-month investigation with customs authorities, resulting in revenue losses of 4,600 million pesos in VAT and special taxes.
